==Usage instructions==
<pre><nowiki>{{Wq|pagename (optional)}}</nowiki></pre>

===Notes===
The optional ''pagename'' argument allows the template to link to a quote page with a different name to the current page. If it is not included the template links to a quote page sharing the same name as the current page.

==Examples==
{{Wq}}
<code><nowiki>{{Wq}}</nowiki></code>

{{Wq|Foo}}
<code><nowiki>{{Wq|Foo}}</nowiki></code>
